title: Straight-line simulation for at most two inputs
statement: Let $n$ satisfy $1\le n\le 2$, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs. There is a valid straight-line program on the same inputs, of length at most the size of $C$, that computes the same Boolean function as $C$.
